title: Is it a working day?
hints: Write `switch (day) { ... }` and give each possible value its own `case`. Anything that doesn't match a `case` lands in `default`.
You can stack several `case` labels on top of each other so they share the same code: `case 1: case 2: ... case 5: return true;`. Weekends and invalid numbers can both go to `default`.
`switch (day) { case 1: case 2: case 3: case 4: case 5: return true; default: return false; }`
